## Decisions

- **Explicit user tap for notification request**: Avoids browser permission fatigue and adheres to PWA best practices.
- **Detect iOS non-standalone mode and guide user to Home Screen install**: Web Push on iOS is only functional when the app has been added to the Home Screen.
